title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0540
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0540
Multiple Vulnerabilities in Drupal Products
Original Issue Date:November  06, 2026
Severity Rating: CRITICAL
Software Affected
AI versions prior to 1.4.11 and 1.5.2
Commerce Core versions prior to 2.41 and 3.3.13
Commerce Stripe versions from 2.0.0 before 2.2.3
OAuth2 Token Manager versions prior to 1.2.0
OAuth Login - OAuth OIDC SSO versions prior to 3.1.1
Single Content Sync versions prior to 1.4.19
Stage File Proxy versions prior to 3.1.7 and 4.0.1
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in Drupal products which could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code, gain unauthorized access, bypass security restrictions, access restricted files or directories, and perform cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
Users of Drupal modules.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of unauthorized access, remote code execution, and bypass of security controls.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for complete system compromise, unauthorized access to sensitive information, and financial impact due to bypassed payment processes.
Description
AI is a module that enables interaction with AI providers. OAuth2 Token Manager allows management of system-wide OAuth2 access and refresh tokens. OAuth Login - OAuth OIDC SSO enables login via OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect identity providers. Single Content Sync facilitates exporting and importing content between Drupal sites. Stage File Proxy provides a solution for retrieving production files on development servers. Commerce Core enables selling goods and services, and Commerce Stripe facilitates payments via the Stripe Connect API.
These vulnerabilities exist in Drupal products due to improper input validation, access control weakness, and cross-site scripting flaws. A remote attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a specially crafted request to the targeted system, or by persuading a victim to click a malicious link.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code, gain unauthorized access, bypass security restrictions, access restricted files or directories, and perform cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks on the targeted system.
Note: The vulnerability in Commerce Core (CVE-2026-118539) is being actively exploited in the wild.
